content:
version: 1

projection:
  id: MONAD-WEB-PROJECTION-001
  name: Monad Website Publication Projection
  status: draft

  contract:
    id: MONAD-PUB-001
    path: specifications/publication/MONAD-PUB-001-publication-projection-contract.md

  source:
    repository: monad-framework/monad
    branch: main

  destination:
    repository: monad-framework/aic-fumadocs-app
    generated_root: content/generated/monad
    public_generated_root: public/generated/monad

defaults:
  disposition: EXCLUDE
  current_state_branch: main
  preserve_source_status: true
  deterministic: true
  ai_authority: forbidden
  deletion_strategy: manifest_inventory
  conflict_strategy: fail
  overwrite_editorial_content: false
  allow_state_regression: false

provenance:
  required: true

  mirror_frontmatter:
    projection: mirror
    source_repository: monad-framework/monad
    source_path: "${source.path}"
    source_commit: "${source.commit}"
    source_blob: "${source.blob}"
    projection_version: 1
    generated: true

  manifest_fields:
    - sourcePath
    - sourceBlob
    - sourceCommit
    - destinationPath
    - mode
    - contentHash

generated_state:
  manifest: content/generated/monad/manifest.json
  provenance: content/generated/monad/provenance.json

  canonical_root: content/generated/monad/canonical

  state:
    project: content/generated/monad/state/project.json
    roadmap: content/generated/monad/state/roadmap.json
    work_packets: content/generated/monad/state/work-packets.json
    milestones: content/generated/monad/state/milestones.json
    risks: content/generated/monad/state/risks.json
    releases: content/generated/monad/state/releases.json
    verification: content/generated/monad/state/verification.json
    artifacts: content/generated/monad/state/artifacts.json
    research: content/generated/monad/state/research.json
    evolution: content/generated/monad/state/evolution.json

transformations:
  markdown_mirror:
    - markdown_to_mdx
    - preserve_semantics
    - preserve_lifecycle_status
    - inject_projection_frontmatter
    - rewrite_internal_links
    - record_provenance
    - record_manifest_entry

  markdown_archive:
    - preserve_semantics
    - preserve_lifecycle_status
    - record_provenance
    - record_manifest_entry

  plain_text_to_mdx:
    - wrap_plain_text
    - inject_projection_frontmatter
    - record_provenance
    - record_manifest_entry

  structured_copy:
    - copy_bytes
    - record_provenance
    - record_manifest_entry

ownership:
  editorial:
    - content/articles/**
    - content/building-monad/**
    - content/journal/**

  editorial_exceptions:
    - content/journal/monad-source/**

  site_owned:
    - app/**
    - components/**
    - lib/**
    - public/**

  site_owned_exceptions:
    - public/generated/monad/**

  generated_namespaces:
    - content/generated/monad/**
    - public/generated/monad/**
    - content/journal/monad-source/**

  protected_existing_content:
    - content/docs/000*.mdx
    - content/docs/AIEOS-*.mdx

publication_policy:
  current_state:
    permitted_source_branches:
      - main

    forbidden_as_current:
      - pull_request
      - feature_branch
      - local_worktree
      - detached_head
      - speculative_projection

  lifecycle:
    publish_draft_on_main: true
    publish_proposed_on_main: true
    publication_implies_acceptance: false
    source_status_is_authoritative: true

  artificial_intelligence:
    may_explain_deterministic_state: true

    may_determine:
      authority: false
      lifecycle_status: false
      acceptance: false
      verification_result: false
      release_readiness: false
      requirement_satisfaction: false
      project_completion: false

live:
  endpoint:
    destination: app/api/monad/status/route.ts
    schema: publication_live_status

  allowed_sources:
    - github_repository
    - github_actions
    - github_pull_requests
    - github_releases

  fields:
    - repository
    - branch
    - headSha
    - projectedSha
    - latestRelease
    - ciState
    - openPullRequests
    - lastProjectionAt
    - lagSeconds
    - freshness

  forbidden_behavior:
    - expose_arbitrary_github_api_response
    - override_canonical_status
    - override_lifecycle_state
    - override_verification_result
    - override_release_readiness

editorial:
  paths:
    - content/articles/**
    - content/building-monad/**
    - content/journal/**

  exceptions:
    - content/journal/monad-source/**

  snapshot_policy:
    state_claiming_articles_should_declare:
      field: monad_snapshot
      value: source_commit

    historical_articles:
      rewrite_on_new_projection: false
      show_snapshot: true
      link_to_current_state: true

exclude:
  # Raw machine and control state.
  - machine/**
  - .eos/**
  - .github/**
  - .monad/**

  # Implementation source.
  - crates/**
  - scripts/**
  - tools/**
  - completions/**
  - bootstrap-*.sh

  # Repository-local implementation/control files.
  - Cargo.lock
  - next-steps.md
  - .editorconfig
  - .gitattributes
  - .gitignore
  - .githubignore

  # Agent/operator prompt material.
  - engineering/prompts/**

  # Any sensitive security material not explicitly admitted by a MIRROR rule.
  - security/private/**
  - security/internal/**
  - security/secrets/**

selected_excluded_inputs:
  # These sources remain excluded from direct publication but may provide the
  # narrowly bounded deterministic facts authorized by DERIVE rules.
  .eos:
    allowed_derived_facts:
      - active_work_packet
      - work_packet_authorization_state
      - work_packet_closed_state
      - active_work_cycle
      - verification_result
      - release_readiness

    forbidden_publication:
      - raw_control_state
      - agent_context
      - internal_prompt_context
      - transient_execution_context
      - secrets

  machine:
    allowed_uses:
      - validation
      - consistency_check
      - projection_input_verification

    authoritative: false
    direct_publication: false

eventing:
  source_event:
    repository: monad-framework/monad
    branch: main
    event: push

  dispatch:
    payload_fields:
      - repository
      - sourceCommit
      - projectionVersion

    payload_is_authoritative_content: false

  consumer_requirements:
    retrieve_exact_commit: true
    verify_source_commit: true
    reject_non_main_current_state: true
    reject_state_regression: true

  ordering:
    strategy: branch_ancestry
    reject_older_projection: true

reconciliation:
  enabled: true

  comparison:
    source: latest_publishable_main_sha
    destination: projected_sha

  self_heal:
    missed_event: true
    failed_workflow: true
    temporary_authentication_failure: true
    interrupted_deployment: true

freshness:
  states:
    CURRENT:
      max_lag_seconds: 300

    SYNCING:
      condition: projection_workflow_active

    STALE:
      min_lag_seconds: 301
      max_lag_seconds: 600

    FAILED:
      min_lag_seconds: 601

  stale_display:
    show_projected_sha: true
    show_source_sha: true
    show_last_successful_projection: true

deletion:
  strategy: manifest_inventory

  requirements:
    previous_manifest_required: true
    delete_only_previously_managed_files: true
    delete_editorial_files: false
    propagate_source_removals: true
    propagate_source_renames: true

conflicts:
  generated_file_modified_manually:
    action: fail

  source_and_destination_disagree:
    action: regenerate_from_authoritative_source

  canonical_and_live_state_disagree:
    action: surface_conflict
    canonical_state_remains_authoritative: true

  canonical_and_machine_projection_disagree:
    action: fail
    canonical_state_remains_authoritative: true

manifest:
  path: content/generated/monad/manifest.json
  complete_inventory: true

  artifact_fields:
    - sourcePath
    - sourceBlob
    - sourceCommit
    - destinationPath
    - mode
    - contentHash

  projection_fields:
    - projectionVersion
    - sourceRepository
    - sourceBranch
    - sourceCommit
    - generatedAt
    - artifacts

invariants:
  - id: PPC-INV-001
    name: Single authority
    assertion: generated_monad_fact_requires_authoritative_monad_source

  - id: PPC-INV-002
    name: Exact provenance
    assertion: generated_output_must_identify_exact_source_revision

  - id: PPC-INV-003
    name: Determinism
    assertion: same_source_commit_and_projection_version_produce_same_semantic_output

  - id: PPC-INV-004
    name: No silent conflict
    assertion: conflicting_state_must_fail_or_be_explicitly_surfaced

  - id: PPC-INV-005
    name: Deletion propagation
    assertion: obsolete_managed_projection_output_must_be_removed

  - id: PPC-INV-006
    name: Editorial preservation
    assertion: projection_must_not_overwrite_editorial_content

  - id: PPC-INV-007
    name: Deny by default
    assertion: unclassified_source_paths_are_excluded

  - id: PPC-INV-008
    name: No state regression
    assertion: older_source_revision_must_not_replace_newer_projected_main_state

  - id: PPC-INV-009
    name: Honest freshness
    assertion: stale_or_failed_projection_state_must_be_visible

  - id: PPC-INV-010
    name: No AI authority
    assertion: ai_must_not_determine_governed_state

  - id: PPC-INV-011
    name: Main-only current state
    assertion: only_authoritative_main_may_be_presented_as_current

  - id: PPC-INV-012
    name: Local reproducibility
    assertion: publication_projection_must_be_reproducible_without_github_actions
